array.string: cd /Users/sudhanshu_thakur/Documents/workspace/binance/trading-system && HOST=127.0.0.1; PORT=3030; PID=$(lsof -tiTCP:${PORT} -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true); if [[ -n "${PID}" ]]; then CWD=$(lsof -a -p "${PID}" -d cwd -Fn 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^n//p' || true); if [[ "${CWD}" == "/Users/sudhanshu_thakur/Documents/workspace/binance/trading-system" ]]; then echo "trading-system backend already listening on ${HOST}:${PORT} (pid=${PID})"; exit 0; fi; echo "refusing to start trading-system backend on ${HOST}:${PORT}: pid=${PID} cwd=${CWD}" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec ./.venv/bin/python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host ${HOST} --port ${PORT}
